title: Infostealer-Sourced Credential Replay Burst from Single IP -- T1078 Valid Accounts (Megalodon + TeamPCP)
author: WRG-11
description:
Detects credential-replay-burst pattern indicative of infostealer-sourced stolen credentials being used in rapid succession across multiple victim accounts from a single source IP.
Attack chain (H Wave 8 + Megalodon + TeamPCP):
(1) Initial compromise via infostealer malware (RedLine, Vidar, Lumma, StealC) deployed on victim endpoints. Infostealer harvests browser- saved credentials, session cookies, MFA bypass tokens, and SSH/VPN config from infected hosts. Per Hudson Rock threat intel: ~33% of Megalodon-affected orgs had infostealer-infected employee endpoints in the preceding 90 days.
(2) Harvested credentials flow to underground marketplaces (Russian Market, Genesis Market predecessor, Telegram bot channels) where TeamPCP-affiliated brokers bulk-purchase.
(3) TeamPCP operator uses single infrastructure node (residential proxy, low-cost VPS) to replay credentials against the originating enterprise auth surface (M365, Okta, Workday, Salesforce, internal SSO) in rapid succession to identify still-valid credentials before rotation.
(4) Composite detection signature: >10 successful authentication events from a single source IP across >10 distinct user accounts within a 1-hour window. Legitimate enterprise auth (corporate VPN exit, gateway, shared library) typically produces high count per ONE account, not many accounts.
Optional enrichment to lower FP rate:
- source_ip matches known infostealer C2 / broker-reseller IP list - user_agent matches known automated replay tooling fingerprint - geo-impossible-travel flag (account base location vs replay IP geo) - MFA challenge skip or bypass cookie reuse pattern
Source: Tier 0 H Wave 8 Front 4 Megalodon profile + TeamPCP UNC6780 actor profile (internal) + Hudson Rock threat intel cited in H Wave 8 cross-reference (internal). Sister cluster: observed_lapsus_t1078.yml (lapsus$ valid accounts pattern in initial_access; this rule extends T1078 to credential_access category from infostealer-fed replay angle).
